stack: local, make up-apps and make up-fiscal; migrations fiscal 0059, sales 0019, procurement 0005, ledger 0006 applied

steps.result: passed: the sale, its return, the purchase return and the value complement were locked and authorized with the support matrix enforced at the lock
one event per lock: sales/normal and fiscal/return, fiscal/complementary, simulation, components CBS, IBS_MUN, IBS_UF; Ledger posts none of them (only legacy taxes in the price are posted)
refused: an accepted offer keeps its estimate
the order keeps the quote estimate digests

steps.command: POST /fiscal/estimates (purchase, supplier stated normal + lucro-real), PUT /procurement/orders/:id/tax-estimate

notOnTheStack: A sale whose lock carries ICMS, PIS or Cofins from Sales: no workspace on the local stack both issues from Sales and has the Phase 85/86 packages adopted. The posting, its idempotence and the return reversal are proven by ledger/test/postings.e2e-spec.ts.
A supplier XML with a different ICMS: the local test supplier XML states no legacy tax and the golden path estimate has none. Proven by fiscal/test/phase44-inbound.e2e-spec.ts.
